description: This file handles the web interface and backend logic for WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) configuration on a wireless network device. It includes PHP code for retrieving Wi-Fi settings, determining WPS availability, and generating a web form with associated JavaScript for user interaction.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN input to ensure it is correctly formatted and passes checksum validation.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX POST request to configure WPS settings based on user input, updating the device configuration.
